note: The cabin a plan card's routes call for (manual §5, since 20 Oct; spec docs/specs/2026-10-21-cabins-new-rule.md §3): if one route takes more than cabin_route_share_pct (65) of the card's block time, the layout that route calls for (its own cabin_choice, else its market's layout), otherwise the layout with the most seats; a low-cost airline flies Standard only. The cabin is the card's variant's layout of that name, among those the airline may choose (a low-cost airline's Standard ones, the others' every other layout). Each answer's problems are the card check's cabin problems (none for a card with no legs, which the check refuses). The world: Test Air (1) and Ryanair (3, low cost); the A321 NEO LIGHT has 321-LEI (195 seats), 321-LEI OLD (172), 321-LP (166), 321-CMF (141) and 321-STD (216); the E195-E2 has E195-LEI (112), E195-CMF (84) and E195-STD (124), and no Leisure Plus. Test Air's routes: HUB–AAA (market Leisure), HUB–CCC (market Comfort, its own choice Leisure Plus), HUB–DDD (market Leisure Plus), HUB–NBN (no market); Ryanair's AAA–DDD (market Standard). HUB–FOC is no route of Test Air's.

cases.name: a route over 65% of the block time: its market's layout; the card's other cabin is a problem
cases.rule: HUB–DDD flies 2 × 160 min daily (2,240 min), HUB–AAA 2 × 75 min three days (450): 83% is over 65%, so its market's Leisure Plus, the A321's 321-LP; the card's 321-LEI differs

answer.reason: HUB–DDD is 83% of block time: Leisure Plus
problems: cabin 321-LEI: the rule calls for 321-LP (HUB–DDD is 83% of block time: Leisure Plus)

cases.name: exactly 65% isn't over: the layout with the most seats
cases.rule: HUB–DDD 2 × 130 min five days (1,300 min) of 2,000: exactly 65%, not over, so the most seats: 321-LEI (195), not the older 321-LEI OLD; the card names it by its code, so nothing differs

answer.reason: no route over 65%: the most seats

cases.name: no route over 65%: the most seats among the airline's layouts (Standard isn't one of a full-service airline's); no cabin on the card is a problem
cases.rule: the E195 on HUB–AAA daily and HUB–DDD three days, its block times estimated (76 and 126 min): 58% and 42%, no route over 65%, so the most seats of E195-LEI (112) and E195-CMF; E195-STD's 124 seats are Ryanair's kind

answer.reason: no route over 65%: the most seats
problems: cabin: none chosen; the rule calls for E195-LEI (no route over 65%: the most seats)
